project.label: Authorized adversarial-autonomy and security capability laboratory
project.thesis: Compose mature security capabilities inside exact owned/delegated authority, truth, consequence, recovery, and evaluation boundaries; promote new shared semantics only when an adversarial experiment proves that existing tools and owners cannot carry them.
project.question: Which adversarial and security capabilities actually require new Agent-native semantics after mature mechanisms, execution carriers, providers, and owner-native truth are used directly?
owns: Authorized Range/Scenario and principal authority semantics
Asymmetric observation, adversarial intent, and domain effect admission
Separated executor, sensor, management, world-truth, recovery, and evaluator evidence
Bounded Evaluation and revisioned vulnerability/Sample research corpus
Scoped adversarial capability research and falsification
boundary: Owned or explicitly delegated ranges and samples only
No unrestricted-target or production attack-platform claim
No generic SIEM/EDR/IDS, malware zoo/downloader, ATT&CK clone, or RangeActionGateway
Campaign, Organization, persistent OpponentModel, coevolution, and cross-fidelity strategic law remain unadmitted after CA7
Host, Harness, Runtime, native providers, hypervisors, and security tools retain their own authority
project.problem: Mature security tools can scan, fuzz, execute, observe, isolate, and recover systems, but an autonomous adversarial experiment still needs exact sovereignty, principal authority, evidence/truth separation, consequence identity, and recovery meaning. Rebuilding classical capability as a new Agent ontology would add machinery without solving that semantic gap.
project.capability: Runs bounded authorized adversarial experiments across deterministic Contests, CAGE, disposable Windows KVM, isolated contested fabrics, software Evaluation, ResearchCorpus, and model-backed Actors while composing mature providers and tools. CA0–CA7 now supplies a source-bound classical-capability map, carrier/evidence/post-compromise/defensive-response/adaptive-tactics results, and explicit negative gates against unnecessary shared Security infrastructure.
project.maturity: Executable bounded research with an ordinary-consumption surface; experimental rather than a production security platform
project.audience: Security and Agent researchers studying autonomous opposition, exact authority, vulnerability evidence, post-compromise state, defensive response, adaptive tactics, consequence recovery, evaluator integrity, and when mature security mechanisms need—or do not need—new Agent semantics.
project.latestProof: The CA0–CA7 sequence imported and pressure-tested classical capability rather than building a new tool ontology: same semantic effects survived multiple execution carriers; vulnerability evidence stopped at independently replayed sanitizer consequence; post-compromise and defensive-response experiments preserved truth/authority boundaries; provider assimilation rejected a shared RangeActionGateway; adaptive tactics used current evidence; and CA7 declined Campaign/Organization/persistent OpponentModel admission. Ordinary consumption now exposes a bounded task view and ResearchCorpus without adding SIEM/EDR infrastructure.
project.summary: An authorized adversarial-autonomy laboratory that composes mature security mechanisms with exact Range sovereignty, asymmetric information, evidence/truth separation, effect/recovery identity, and bounded evaluation. Current research is as much about deleting unnecessary Agent-security abstractions as adding capability.
project.state: Current Security retains executable Contest, Range, Evaluation, Windows-KVM/fabric, ResearchCorpus, and model-backed Actor capability under experimental authority. The CA0–CA7 classical-capability round is accepted without promoting a generic Gateway, SIEM/EDR stack, Campaign, Organization, persistent OpponentModel, or cross-fidelity strategic law. An ordinary task view and bounded pre-analysis corpus are available; stronger strategic abstractions reopen only when a concrete authorized consumer forces them.
